text:
Amanda C: heads-up — got an alert from our monitoring that an on-prem node tried to reach an external storage endpoint through the private gateway and failed 403. filing here for triage.
Liam R: can you paste the alert id? also which customer/vpc?
Amanda C: alert id a-98721, tenant: acme-edge, region: eu-west-1. looks like egress denied by netpol?
Sara K: pulling logs from the proxy now. curious if this is a KMS deny (key access) or pure network. pinging ops-bot for the correlation.
ops-bot: Incident correlation: alert a-98721 linked to flow 3921, netpol drop on namespace acme-edge, tcp/443 to s3-compatible. No KMS denies recorded in last 10m.
Jordan P: good catch. netpol update rolled 12:10 UTC in that cluster for stricter egress. who applied it?
Amanda C: looks like a config churn from the isolation-sprint; @Liam R approved the change yesterday?
Liam R: i approved a scoped deny but i thought we excluded jumpbox and the private-gateway service account. will check.
Sara K: grabbing kube-audit logs. snippet: ```json
{"verb":"update","user":"system:serviceaccount:infra:private-gateway","object":"networkpolicies/network-isolate","timestamp":"2025-11-07T12:10:02Z"}
```
Amanda C: that serviceaccount is the gateway runtime. if it lost egress role we need to revert.
security-oncall: flagging as sev-2. we should do temporary mitigation: add policy exception for private-gateway SA and collect full KMS access logs for the 12:00–12:20 window.
Jordan P: agreed. mitigation plan: 1) add egress allow for svc account, 2) rotate temporary KMS key binding if we detect unauthorized use, 3) run audit export for both kube-audit and kms-audit, 4) postmortem.
Liam R: rolling the exception now (kubectl apply -f -):
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-gateway-egress-temp
  namespace: acme-edge
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: private-gateway
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector: {}
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```
Sara K: ops-bot confirms change applied. flow from private-gateway to s3 now allowed. retry from tenant shows success.
ops-bot: Action log: networkpolicy/allow-gateway-egress-temp created by Liam R at 2754312360.
Amanda C: ok immediate user impact remediated. next: KMS review. no denies earlier but we should export CloudHSM/KMS audit trail for that tenant for last 24h.
security-oncall: also add a short-term RBAC lockdown: revoke any recently added broad permissions in infra namespace. run `kubectl get rolebindings -n infra -o wide` and look for changes in last 48h.
Jordan P: i've started an RBAC diff against baseline. found a RoleBinding that granted cluster-level list on secrets to infra:deploy-bot — created 11/02. marking for rollback if not expected.
Liam R: that binding was to speed up staging deploys. i will revert to namespace-scoped role and re-run canary.
Sara K: exporting kube-audit and kms-audit bundles to s3://redwood-sec-audit/rollups/a-98721/ now. ETA ~25m.
Amanda C: will coordinate postmortem doc. owners: Amanda, Sara, Jordan. security-oncall please add incident entry and runthrough for runbook.
security-oncall: created incident INC-2025-1107-01, scheduled runthrough 15:00 UTC. reminder: we need to tighten our netpol PR checklist to include explicit allow-lists for gateway SAs and a small automated test that asserts egress for private-gateway at deploy time.
Jordan P: also propose an audit logproof task: ship a daily digest that cross-checks networkpolicy changes with recent kube-audit updates and flags diffs that modify egress on system SAs.
Amanda C: agree. add to backlog and prioritize as P0 for isolation-sprint follow-up.
Liam R: patched RBAC, removed broad binding, re-deployed gateway with no downtime. will post diff in the PR.
ops-bot: compliance note: KMS key rotation not triggered. no suspicious encrypt/decrypt calls from unknown principals for tenant acme-edge.
Sara K: uploading final bundle and brief timeline to the incident doc.
Amanda C: thanks all. closing thread once runthrough done and postmortem posted. :white_check_mark:
